name: Sakuragi Amane
source: The protagonist's classmate, she often takes care of him. Like the protagonist, she is also isolated so they are good friends and get along well. She says stuff like how the protagonist is her first friend. Quiet and always looks like she is about to fall asleep, a strange girl that no one knows what she is thinking. Reacts negatively to everything, she is the type of girl that stays on the sidelines.
